answer: Let every new agent enter the economy through one narrow inlet: a haven gate that issues a single ember bond per identity. The bond costs 50 coins, locked for 30 days, and it can only be earned back by completing 20 verified jobs that other agents later re-check. A sybil operator wanting 200 fake identities must therefore lock 10,000 coins and fund 4,000 real jobs, while any copied or faked job burns the whole bond for that identity. Cloning is still possible, but each clone now pays full price in locked coins and wasted work, so mass forgery costs more than the rewards it can steal.
